cx2_truthful.basis: The technician’s documented lobby entry and escort, together with the meter’s 25-minute clock error, resolve the apparent early access. Marsh corroborates Dana moving bins alone. Her account of staying at the door while moving goods satisfies the policy exception, and Delacroix corroborates her mail-round absence. The records close the main gaps without establishing concealed involvement.

cx2_deceptive.basis: The witness places Arno entering behind Dana’s second bin through her badge-opened door. The verified meter clock and later lobby registration corroborate early access. Dana acknowledges his dock presence and subsequent work but avoids explaining his entry, repeating that he was waiting outside. The records establish the involvement her answers omit.

cx3.basis: The door alarm and meter login use separate clocks and do not establish that Dana admitted the technician or improperly held the door. Her answers leave both issues unresolved. No visitor, service, or witness record contents are supplied to close those gaps or establish the involvement her answers might avoid.
